key_decisions.decision: Retains title attribution and home image across generations.
Preserves the birth imagery and God's unbounded duration.
Renders crushed material as dust with a note and preserves the double return.
Preserves flooding away, sleep and fresh grass images.
Follows qere set; keeps illumination of what is hidden.
Keeps exact ages, limited strength and the flight image.
Retains the difficult relation between wrath and fear without redefining fear as mere respect.
Keeps counting as the route to wise-hearted living.
Retains the deliberate full closing repetition.
